topics.label: Course introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the administrative opening, course overview, and learning outcomes for the lecture series.

topics.label: Cellular and tissue foundations of cancer development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how cancer originates from accumulated genetic and epigenetic alterations leading to a failure of cellular differentiation and tissue architecture.

topics.label: Characteristics, progression, and nomenclature of benign and malignant tumors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how benign and malignant tumors are distinguished through invasion, metastasis, histological progression, and systematic nomenclature.

topics.label: Pathophysiological mechanisms of cancer morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the physical and systemic mechanisms by which primary tumors and distant metastases cause illness and patient death.

topics.label: Comparative incidence of cancer across humans and other species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the epidemiology and incidence of different cancer types in humans and across diverse animal taxa.

topics.label: Principles and methods of cancer screening and early detection
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the clinical rationale, tissue-specific techniques, and practical limitations of population screening for various cancers.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and practical reminders
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding closing remarks and instructions for upcoming practical sessions.
